description: This file implements data retention and cleanup functions for a SQL store in the Mattermost Focalboard project, including deletion of old board-related data based on retention policies.

classes.name: RetentionTableDeletionInfo
classes.description: Struct holding information about tables and primary keys for data retention deletion.

methods.name: runDataRetention
methods.description: Executes data retention policy, deleting old board data based on retention date.

methods.name: idsFromRows
methods.description: Extracts IDs from SQL query result rows.

methods.name: genericRetentionPoliciesDeletion
methods.description: Performs deletion of records from specified tables based on IDs and batch size.
